title: ProtModernBERT: Compute-Efficient Protein Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.19738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large protein language models provide a powerful framework for learning sequence-function relationships and guiding experimental design. However, architectural improvements are underexplored, especially in low-compute regimes of relevance for resource-constrained research laboratories. We show that the training cost for encoder-only transformer architectures can be reduced by leveraging modern architectural refinements, offering an encouraging performance / compute-efficiency trade-off. translated_title: ProtModernBERT：计算高效的蛋白质语言建模
translated_abstract: 大型蛋白质语言模型为学习序列-功能关系和指导实验设计提供了强大的框架。然而，架构方面的改进尚未得到充分探索，尤其是在与资源受限的研究实验室相关的低算力场景中。我们展示了通过利用现代架构改进技术，可以降低仅编码器Transformer架构的训练成本，从而提供令人鼓舞的性能与计算效率之间的权衡。我们提出了ProtModernBERT，这是一个在氨基酸序列上预训练的现代化BERT风格模型，并将其与ProtBert、Amplify和ESM2在一系列监督结构任务（包括二级结构预测、无序区域预测和亚细胞定位）以及ProteinGym的零样本功能基准测试上进行比较。我们发现，ProtModernBERT在训练计算量减少高达80-90%的情况下，能够达到或接近Amplify-120M和ProtBert的性能水平。
tldr: ProtModernBERT通过现代化架构改进，以减少高达80-90%的训练计算量实现了与ProtBert和Amplify-120M相当的性能，为资源受限的研究实验室提供了高效的蛋白质语言建模方案。
en_tdlr: ProtModernBERT leverages modern architectural refinements to match the performance of ProtBert and Amplify-120M with up to 80-90% less training compute, offering an efficient protein language model for resource-constrained research settings.
